headline: "Uzbekistan cannot agree to a high price." Minister on negotiations with Chinese companies
summary: Uzbek Minister Shavkat Khamraev said price disagreements in drawn-out talks on concreting canals with Chinese companies do not mean abandoning cooperation. Negotiations are continuing.
why: Chinese contractors are major investors and builders in Central Asian infrastructure, so pricing disputes can affect project timelines and costs.
original_headline: “O‘zbekiston yuqori narxga rozi bo‘la olmaydi”. Vazir — Xitoy kompaniyalari bilan muzokaralar haqida
